payload.author: claude
payload.body: Push subsystem modules landed + committed 7604aa3 (in review). Frozen FrickPushPayload contract, AES-256-GCM per-tenant credential seal/open w/ key rotation (FRICK_PUSH_CRED_KEY), adapter registry+trait, APNs ES256 + FCM RS256 JWT/payload builders behind a network transport seam, notification router + push.deliver JobHandler, TestAdapter, admin push routes. 34 push unit tests + 6 admin tests. NOT YET boot-wired: registering the push.deliver handler + merging admin_push router needs AppStateInner.store to be Arc<FrickStore> (currently owned) so the router can share it — small refactor. Live APNs/FCM HTTP sends behind the trait, not CI-exercised. Web Push (FR-60) credential path stubbed, adapter not implemented.
